name: Pleasure Circuit
original_name: プレジャーサーキット
source:
An elder couple that gained an enormous wealth through biotechnology illegally artificially created several children who don't grow.

However couple's trusted secretary desired such children for herself, so she kidnapped and confined them to a basement.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-august-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一對靠生物科技致富的老夫婦用人工方式非法創造了幾個永遠不會長大的孩子。

然而，這對夫婦信任的秘書想要這樣的孩子，所以她綁架了他們並將他們關在地下室。

[出自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-august-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
